independent_individual_result.study: Peng, Gui, Brucks, Johnson, Toubia et al., 'Digital Twins as Funhouse Mirrors: Five Key Distortions' (Columbia Business School, 2026)
independent_individual_result.twin_training: 500+ of each person's own prior answers (~128k chars psychometric data per person)
independent_individual_result.note: Pre-registered peer study. Feeding 500+ real answers per person lifted individual accuracy only +1.4pp over zero personalization (0.748 vs 0.734). Robustness ran across GPT-4.1, GPT-5, DeepSeek, Gemini incl fine-tuned - all similarly modest. Authors: structural limit, not a model-choice problem a better LLM solves next quarter. Kills the 'newer model fixes it' objection.

independent_benchmark_2607.study: LLMs as Synthetic Survey Respondents (arXiv 2607.26348, Jul 30 2026)
independent_benchmark_2607.finding: no tested LLM outperforms simple statistical baselines at predicting individual responses; all models overestimate the predictive power of demographics -> distorted segment targeting; persists across model sizes, families, and domains
independent_benchmark_2607.note: Independent Jul-2026 benchmark reproducing our two core findings: dumb baseline wins at the individual level, and demographics are systematically over-weighted.
